hook: The next circle of security hell
hookText: The next circle of security hell

beats.say: A Gentoo developer writes about the next layer of security hardening and why each new defense seems to add another circle of complexity.
A few years back I wrote “The modern packager’s security nightmare”. In the end, security is tricky.
The point is that nowadays everyone and their chatbot became security researchers. On the contrary, I feel like we’re slipping down a well-oiled slope with no end in sight.
